`requirements.md` has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-bugfix-eyedropper-dark-theme/requirements.md` covering:

1. **Reproduction**: Exact steps in dark theme (`THEME.DARK`) and observed vs. expected colours (`#ffffff` rendered as `#121212` and saved raw as `#121212` instead of `#ffffff`; `#1e1e1e` rendered as `#d3d3d3` and saved raw as `#d3d3d3` instead of `#1e1e1e`).
2. **Diagnosis**: Root cause traced across `applyDarkModeFilter` in `packages/common/src/colors.ts`, raw `ctx.getImageData` pixel sampling in `packages/excalidraw/components/EyeDropper.tsx`, and its downstream callers/consumers in `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.bucketFill.ts`, and `packages/excalidraw/components/App.cursor.ts`.
3. **In Scope / Out of Scope**: Scoped strictly to the 8 allowlisted files and Gate 0 decisions.
4. **Functional & Non-Functional Requirements**: FR-1 through FR-6 and NFR-1 through NFR-4.
5. **PII Inventory & Role Matrix**: Marked as none / not applicable.
6. **Acceptance Criteria & Open Questions**: AC-1 through AC-6 mapping all brief criteria, with no open questions.
